Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (JMA ORCA open-source project)

purpose.summary: This program is a screen-handling subprogram (window XG04) within the JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt software system. It manages an output-selection screen for medical information system data export, reading from a 'tbl_file_mis' database table and populating screen/SPA areas with file output records. It handles initialization, screen transitions, and entry events via an EVALUATE on MCP-STATUS/MCP-EVENT.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt system)

notable_features: Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS/EUC encoded, stored as latin-1)
JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system (copyright 2002 Japan Medical Association)
Extensive use of COPY statements for shared SPA/linkage areas
MCP (Message Control Program) interface pattern typical of ORCA's OpenCOBOL/GnuCOBOL framework
EVALUATE ALSO (multiple subject EVALUATE) for event-driven screen dispatch
BINARY PIC S9(9) for row index
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP database access layer
SEARCH with VARYING and AT END for table lookup
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese multi-byte characters (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) in comments and string literals, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. The 'online-cics' program_type label is used loosely — ORCA uses its own MCP event-driven framework analogous to CICS, not actual CICS. No COMP-3 usage despite being a production system, which is consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL targets.
